title: Cloud City: Cheat Sheet: Hybrid Connectivity (HA VPN vs Interconnect)
city_concept: City Regional Aqueducts & Covered Mountain Tunnels

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Caravans between Cloud City and the mountain mining village were frequently robbed by bandits on open dirt roads.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Warden Ward built two secure transport paths: Armed Courier Convoys (HA VPN) and a Private Paved Highway with stone guardrails (Interconnect).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When a rockslide blocked Tunnel 1, automated signal towers (BGP) routed wagons through Tunnel 2 without delay.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Digging mountain tunnels takes years; Cloud HA VPN tunnels can be deployed and validated in 30 minutes.
